name: Crook’s Coin
body:
Price 8,000 gp; Slot none; CL 5th; Weight —; Aura faint abjuration

DESCRIPTION

This standard gold coin typically has two blank faces, but its owner can cause a butterfly with the sun, the moon, and stars on its wings—to appear on either face at will. This proves especially useful when performing coin flips, as the owner of a Crook’s coin can essentially guarantee that the result will end up in her favor.

In addition, its bearer gains a +2 luck bonus on Reflex saving throws.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells divine favor
